threatVisibility.method: Existing read-only500ms state observer: submitted living crowd body, head projected inside the camera, native line-of-sight predicate. Positive observations only, plus maximum sampling gap. No frame-interval/performance data used. This scopes geometric camera coverage; it does not prove all pixel occlusions.

sparseDrivingLogVisibility.method: Positive observations only: actual submitted, on-screen living infected within 32m, every logged driving observation. Missing distant figures cannot create a false positive. Bound includes the maximum sampling gap. A bound above60s is inconclusive: brief visible passes can fall between logged samples, so this never establishes a FAIL. No frame timing measured.

subtitle.text: The crash took everything but the axe. The others made it to the evacuation point while you fell behind. Find the research campus and the cure.
